evidence_category: Formal exact finite identity and conditional scalar recurrence implication
exact_identity: B^(r+1)+sum_{j<r} B^(j+1)(2B)^(r-j) = B^(r+1)(2^(r+1)-1), for every real B and natural r.
conditional_result: If B>=1, d_r<=1 for r<n0, and d_r<=B^(r+1)+sum_{j<r}B^(j+1)d_(r-1-j) for r>=n0, then d_r<=(2B)^(r+1) for every r. No nonnegativity of d is required.
proof: Exact finite-sum induction, followed by strong induction and nonnegative geometric weights. No infinite sum or asymptotic limit is used.
limits: The actual PDE recurrence and its normalization are still to be proved; this conditional scalar result does not discharge them.
